dialogues.jp: 「お待たせ」
dialogues.en: "Here you go!"
dialogues.text: "Here you go!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ありがと〜」
dialogues.en: "Ah, thank you~"
dialogues.text: "Ah, thank you~"

dialogues.jp:
ベンチに座ることりに紅茶の缶を渡し、俺は隣
に腰を下ろした。
dialogues.en:
I passed her a drink packet of black tea, and sat down next
to her.
dialogues.text:
I passed her a drink packet of black tea, and sat down next
to her.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、いただきま〜す」
dialogues.en: "Then, let's begin!"
dialogues.text: "Then, let's begin!"

dialogues.jp:
布の包みを開き、ちんまりした弁当箱の｛ふた／蓋｝を開
ける。俺は、パンの包装を開いた。
dialogues.en:
As usual, she spread out a cloth on her lap, put her
lunchbox on it, and opened it. Also as usual, I opened my
bread packet.
dialogues.text:
As usual, she spread out a cloth on her lap, put her
lunchbox on it, and opened it. Also as usual, I opened my
bread packet.

dialogues.jp: 「いただきます、と」
dialogues.en: "Let's begin, indeed."
dialogues.text: "Let's begin, indeed."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……何か、朝倉君って、いつもパンだよね」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-kun, you're always eating bread."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-kun, you're always eating bread."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん〜、そうでもないけど。食堂も利用するし」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm, that's not really true. I do use the cafeteria
occasionally."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm, that's not really true. I do use the cafeteria
occasionally."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「他には？」
dialogues.en: "And besides that?"
dialogues.text: "And besides that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、食堂とパンのローテーションだな」
dialogues.en: "Well, the cafeteria and bread rotation."
dialogues.text: "Well, the cafeteria and bread rotation."

dialogues.jp:
あっという間に一個を消費し、二つ目に取りか
かる。ことりはまだ、口を付けてさえいない。
dialogues.en:
I took a bite out of my bread as I talked. Kotori still
hadn't started on her lunch yet.
dialogues.text:
I took a bite out of my bread as I talked. Kotori still
hadn't started on her lunch yet.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「今度から、私がおべんと作ってきてあげるよ」
dialogues.en: "Next time, I'd make a lunchbox for you as well."
dialogues.text: "Next time, I'd make a lunchbox for you as well."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いや、それはさすがに遠慮しておく」
dialogues.en: "No, you shouldn't trouble yourself with that."
dialogues.text: "No, you shouldn't trouble yourself with that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え〜？　どうして？　美味しいよ。ほら……」
dialogues.en: "Ehh~? Why? It's good, here, try it yourself!"
dialogues.text: "Ehh~? Why? It's good, here, try it yourself!"

dialogues.jp: 唇を尖らせて、箸を口に持ってくる。
dialogues.en:
She thrust her chopsticks past my lips, and into my mouth,
surprisingly forcefully.
dialogues.text:
She thrust her chopsticks past my lips, and into my mouth,
surprisingly forcefully.

dialogues.jp:
「ん……もぐ……いや、美味い事は美味いんだ
　けどさ。やっぱ、悪いだろ」
dialogues.en:
"M... *chew*... no, I know it's delicious... but it'd be
troublesome for you."
dialogues.text:
"M... *chew*... no, I know it's delicious... but it'd be
troublesome for you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そんな事ないよ。一人分も二人分も、あんま
　り変わらないし」
dialogues.en:
"Not really. There's no major difference in making one or
two portions."
dialogues.text:
"Not really. There's no major difference in making one or
two portions."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、まあ、そういうのは｛・・／たま｝の楽しみに取っ
　ておくよ。お花見の時とかな」
dialogues.en:
"But, actually, that reminds me, we always talked about
going flower-viewing but never ended up doing it during
spring break."
dialogues.text:
"But, actually, that reminds me, we always talked about
going flower-viewing but never ended up doing it during
spring break."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん〜、そう？　ちょっと残念……」
dialogues.en: "Hm, you're right. I completely forgot."
dialogues.text: "Hm, you're right. I completely forgot."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、じゃあさ、早速、今度の土曜にお花見し
　ようよ」
dialogues.en: "How about this Saturday, we do that?"
dialogues.text: "How about this Saturday, we do that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、いいな。土曜は昼で終わりだし」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, sure. After noon, that is."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, sure. After noon, that is."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「この学園、土曜日は半日で終わるからいいよ
　ね。もし、平日と同じだったら、ほんとに会
　う時間なんてないもん」
dialogues.en:
"It's good that the school only has half-days on Saturday.
If it were full-days, we really wouldn't have time to meet."
dialogues.text:
"It's good that the school only has half-days on Saturday.
If it were full-days, we really wouldn't have time to meet."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、聖歌隊の事な」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, with your choir activities."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, with your choir activities."

dialogues.jp:
ことりは日曜日は、聖歌隊の練習で大半が潰れ
てしまう。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's Sundays are almost entirely taken up with choir
practice.
dialogues.text:
Kotori's Sundays are almost entirely taken up with choir
practice.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、まあ、ちょうどいいだろ。結局、花よ
　り団子になるんだろうから」
dialogues.en:
"It's a good thing I guess. It's a case of dumplings over
flowers."
dialogues.text:
"It's a good thing I guess. It's a case of dumplings over
flowers."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、校門の向こうの桜並木に目を向け
た。
dialogues.en:
I glanced at the school entrance, and the line of sakura
trees following it.
dialogues.text:
I glanced at the school entrance, and the line of sakura
trees following it.

dialogues.jp: 「あれを毎日見てるんだから、な」
dialogues.en: "We see those everyday, after all."
dialogues.text: "We see those everyday, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それもそうかもね」
dialogues.en: "Uh huh."
dialogues.text: "Uh huh."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ではでは、私は『団子』の方を丹誠込めて作
　るから、楽しみに待っててね」
dialogues.en:
"Then I'd word hard on making the "dumpling", so you can
enjoy it!"
dialogues.text:
"Then I'd word hard on making the "dumpling", so you can
enjoy it!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Right!"
dialogues.text: "Right!"

dialogues.jp: ◆お花見◆
dialogues.en: ◆Flower Viewing◆
dialogues.text: ◆Flower Viewing◆

dialogues.jp:
二人で昼食を取る。俺の食生活を見て、お弁当
を作ると言ってくれたが、さすがに遠慮した。
dialogues.en:
Kotori and I ate lunch together. After seeing and hearing of
my eating habits, she offered to make a lunchbox for me, but
I had my reservations.
dialogues.text:
Kotori and I ate lunch together. After seeing and hearing of
my eating habits, she offered to make a lunchbox for me, but
I had my reservations.

dialogues.jp: 代わりに、花見に行くことにした。
dialogues.en:
As a substitute, I brought up the flower-viewing trip we
were suppposed to go on.
dialogues.text:
As a substitute, I brought up the flower-viewing trip we
were suppposed to go on.

dialogues.jp:
日曜日は、ことりは聖歌隊の練習があるので、
今度の土曜日という事に決まった。
dialogues.en:
Kotori had her choir practice on Sundays, so we decided to
schedule it for the coming Saturday.
dialogues.text:
Kotori had her choir practice on Sundays, so we decided to
schedule it for the coming Saturday.
